comparison.objective: Measure tyre pressure with a pencil gauge and return it; candidate separates ceramic media from retained washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Gauge work tests millimetric coaxial sealing, valve depression, sustained pressure, and tool replacement rather than load-sharing and sifting.
comparison.success_condition: A sealed 1.5 s press, 33–37 psi indication, gauge returned and released; candidate grades recovery fraction plus retention, support, spill prevention, and 3 s dwell.
comparison.reason: Tool-to-valve sealing and measurement do not test selective many-body passage through apertures; no material rubric detail is missing.
